amortization_expense.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.
amortization_expense.label: Amortization Expense

basic_eps.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.
basic_eps.label: Basic Earnings per Share

cash_dividends_per_share.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.
cash_dividends_per_share.label: Cash Dividends to Common per Share

comprehensive_income.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events/circumstances from net income and OCI. Includes portion attributable to NCI.
comprehensive_income.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss)

comprehensive_income_nci.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events, attributable to noncontrolling interests.
comprehensive_income_nci.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss) Attributable to NCI

comprehensive_income_parent.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events, attributable to parent.
comprehensive_income_parent.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

costs_and_expenses.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.
costs_and_expenses.label: Costs & Expenses

depreciation_and_amortization.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives.
depreciation_and_amortization.label: Depreciation and Amortization

depreciation_expense.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.
depreciation_expense.label: Depreciation Expense

diluted_eps.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.
diluted_eps.label: Diluted Earnings per Share

income_before_equity_method.description: Amount of income/loss from continuing operations before income from equity method investments.
income_before_equity_method.label: Income Before Equity Method Investments

income_tax_current.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.
income_tax_current.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

income_tax_deferred.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.
income_tax_deferred.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

income_tax_expense.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.
income_tax_expense.label: Income Tax Expense

net_income.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
net_income.label: Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)

net_income_continuing.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
net_income_continuing.label: Net Income / (Loss) Continuing Operations

net_income_to_common.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.
net_income_to_common.label: Net Income / (Loss) Attributable to Common Shareholders

operating_cost_of_revenue.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.
operating_cost_of_revenue.label: Operating Cost of Revenue

operating_revenue.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).
operating_revenue.label: Operating Revenue

other_adjustments_to_consolidated_net_in.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).
other_adjustments_to_consolidated_net_in.label: Other Adjustments to Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)

other_comprehensive_income_parent.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of OCI attributable to parent.
other_comprehensive_income_parent.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

other_depreciation_and_amortization.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Depreciation and Amortization minus explicitly mapped children.
other_depreciation_and_amortization.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization

other_income.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.
other_income.label: Other Income / (Expense), net

other_income_tax_expense.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Income Tax Expense minus explicitly mapped children.
other_income_tax_expense.label: Other Income Tax Expense

other_net_income.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Consolidated Net Income / (Loss) minus explicitly mapped children.
other_net_income.label: Other Consolidated Net Income / (Loss)

other_operating_expenses.description: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.
other_operating_expenses.label: Other Operating Expenses / (Income)

other_pretax_income.description: Synthetic balancing plug derived from Total Pre-Tax Income  minus explicitly mapped children.
other_pretax_income.label: Other Pre-Tax Income

rd_expense.description: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.
rd_expense.label: Research & Development Expense

sga_expense.description: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.
sga_expense.label: Selling, General & Admin Expense

total_cost_of_revenue.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.
total_cost_of_revenue.label: Total Cost of Revenue

total_gross_profit.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.
total_gross_profit.label: Total Gross Profit

total_interest_expense.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.
total_interest_expense.label: Interest Expense

total_interest_income.description: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.
total_interest_income.label: Interest & Investment Income

total_operating_expenses.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.
total_operating_expenses.label: Total Operating Expenses

total_operating_income.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.
total_operating_income.label: Total Operating Income

total_other_income.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).
total_other_income.label: Total Other Income / (Expense), net

total_pretax_income.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.
total_pretax_income.label: Total Pre-Tax Income

total_revenue.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).
total_revenue.label: Total Revenue

weighted_ave_basic_shares_os.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.
weighted_ave_basic_shares_os.label: Weighted Average Basic Shares Outstanding

weighted_ave_diluted_shares_os.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
weighted_ave_diluted_shares_os.label: Weighted Average Diluted Shares Outstanding
